blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — ZUS Coffee spoiled Jean Asis’ 27-point career night and dragged Galeries Tower to elimination with a come-from-behind 17-25, 21-25, 25-20, 25-20, 15-12 win in the 2027 PVL All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series on Tuesday night at Smart Araneta Coliseum. AC Miner showed her versatility, returning to her original middle blocker role in the last three sets to finish with 17 points off 13 kills and four blocks, helping end the Thunderbelles’ five-game skid to tie with the HighRisers, who came off their first win last week. “We came into this game knowing we had to give everything we had.
